Name: Jaalam
Summary: Jaalam was a son of Esau by Aholibamah, and one of the dukes of Edom.
KeyStory: Jaalam is named with his brothers Jeush and Korah among Aholibamah's sons and among Edom's dukes.
RelatedPeople: Esau; Aholibamah; Jeush; Korah, Son of Esau
LifeLesson: God's story keeps moving through families we know almost nothing about — and He knows them all.
